description: This file defines various classes related to asynchronous work items within the Orleans runtime scheduler. It includes classes for executing closures (tasks with associated contexts) asynchronously, capturing their completion state, and providing identifiers for the work items.

classes.name: AsyncClosureWorkItem
classes.description: Represents an asynchronous work item that executes a provided Task-returning closure, providing completion notification and contextual information.

classes.name: AsyncClosureWorkItem<T>
classes.description: Generic version of AsyncClosureWorkItem that handles closures returning a result of type T, facilitating asynchronous execution with result handling.

classes.name: ClosureWorkItem<TState>
classes.description: Handles execution of a delegate Action with associated state, and tracks completion or exceptions.

methods.name: GetMethodName
methods.description: Returns a string representing the method name for a delegate, useful for identifying the work item.
